messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Assalam o Alaikum, main ApnaBank fraud department se bol raha hoon, officer ID AB-4471.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aap ke account se 50,000 rupay ka suspicious transaction detect hua hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Transaction? Maine to kuch nahi kiya!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Isi liye to call ki hai. Rokne ke liye verification zaroori hai turant.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Abhi aap ko ek OTP bheja ja raha hai, woh code batao mujhe.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Foran batao, account block hone se pehle! Kisi ko na batana yeh confidential matter hai.
